title: Names Under Glass
invitation: Ina has Ivo’s slip below the cathedral stairs.

panels.text: Blue light from Lugia’s window falls across a stretcher. Ina has set out dry socks in pairs on the rail beside it.

panels.speaker: Ina Quill
panels.text: I told Ivo his case was closed. He was standing right there. He took his shoes off and asked if he could stay anyway.
Ina puts his slip on the table. It says EMPTY. When she turns it toward the lamp, you can see the grooves left by names written on the sheet above.

choices.label: Take Ina’s signed account
choices.detail: File the time as Ina remembers it.
choices.reply: Ina writes 17:14 beside CLOSED and signs beneath it. She taps twice. “That’s what I heard from inside the cart.” She sends you to Plateau registration.
choices.clue: Ina’s signed account and closure time

choices.label: Make a carbon copy
choices.detail: Recover the names and leave Ina the original.
choices.reply: Under your pencil the names come back. So does the time stamped beside CLOSED. 17:14. Ina finds an envelope. “Ask for disputed returns at Plateau. You can open it there.”
choices.clue: Carbon impression of names and closure time

echoes.text: Ina checks Ivo’s signature and puts it with the shelter file. “I’ll leave the witnesses a clean page each. They can fill them in.”
Two hikers are drying their laces by the kettle. When you ask for Ivo’s slip, one lifts the kettle with both hands. “He said you’d come for this.”

secret.title: Case Closed, Witness Present
secret.hint: Check the closure time against Ivo’s signed relay call.
secret.text: Recovery closed the case at 17:14. Three minutes later Ivo was still on the pass, giving his name over the radio. On his copy he’s underlined the time twice.

title: The Intake Window
invitation: Ask Orin about disputed returns at Plateau registration.

panels.speaker: Registration loudspeaker
panels.text: Next challenger to the window. Keep the aisle clear.
The badge reader chirps for the next challenger. Orin uses an Ultra Ball to prop open the drawer for disputed returns.

panels.speaker: Orin Beck
panels.text: Our seal. That little bit missing at the bottom is ours too. The first complaint’s been in here through two renewals. The first time I saw it I put it back.
Orin runs a ruler down the ledger. The fee beside each closed case is the same. On the line that says EMPTY, the fee has been paid.

choices.label: Take a sealed copy
choices.detail: Keep the complaint private until you reach Mara.
choices.reply: Orin copies the complaint, the renewal, and the disputed intake total. He seals them and writes Crucible service entrance on the envelope. “Ask for Mara. Hand it to her.”

choices.label: Put the case on the public register
choices.detail: Let other families find the case number.
choices.reply: Orin enters the case number and intake total on the public register. A challenger copies both. “Where do I ask about mine?” Orin writes the Crucible address on their slip.
choices.clue: Public case receipt and inquiry address

echoes.text: Orin sets Ina’s signed account beside the case. “I should ask her if she wants us to call this testimony.” He leaves the field blank and reaches for the phone.
The names line up with four unclaimed numbers. Orin moves the file out of the drawer. He puts a sheet over the names before calling the next challenger.

secret.title: The Second Register
secret.hint: Compare the Plateau intake total with the cathedral record.
secret.text: The two ledgers use the same transfer number. The League’s copy counts four fewer passengers. Against the omitted tags, one instruction has been written four times. DO NOT NOTIFY.

title: On the Record
invitation: Ivo has asked to give his account at the service door.

panels.text: Behind the service door you can barely hear the arena. Mara has brought the old relay lamp. Ivo keeps moving his chair until he can see who comes in.

panels.speaker: Ivo
panels.text: We got the Pokémon out first. One couldn’t stand, so I lifted it by the harness. When the cart pulled away, someone was still knocking. I keep trying to remember what side it was on.
Mara lays down the intake record. Ivo draws a line through RECOVERED and writes PRESENT. He holds the pen in both hands until you’re ready to take it.

choices.label: Take his account in private
choices.detail: Share it with the families involved.
choices.reply: Ivo shuts the door and starts with the harnesses. When it’s over, Mara reads the account back. He corrects one word. Then he folds the signed copy with the names inside.
choices.clue: Ivo’s signed account and transfer number. The other witnesses’ names stay private.
choices.consequence: Mara will put families in touch with Ivo privately.
choices.townNote: Ivo is meeting with families one at a time behind the service door.

choices.label: Witness his public statement
choices.detail: Put Ivo’s name on the public correction.
choices.reply: Ivo signs at the top. “Mine can go up. Leave the others a place to sign if they come.” Mara takes a copy outside. He waits for the sound of the pin going in.
choices.clue: Ivo’s public correction to the Recovery record, filed under his own name.
choices.consequence: Ivo’s correction goes on the noticeboard under his name.
choices.townNote: People have started pinning their case numbers under Ivo’s correction.

echoes.text: Ivo holds the renewal up beside his release. “Could you make a bigger copy of that date? People ought to be able to see it from across the table.”
Mara has two notes already. Both start with the same case number you heard called at Plateau. The second asks if the door will be open tomorrow.
Ivo sets his maintenance ticket beside your first rubbing. The punch marks match. “That was the shift I missed supper,” he says. Mara writes the date down before he can put the ticket away.
The walker brings their Growlithe. Its paw is fine. They tell Ivo they’ve been lighting the relay on the way home. “Would you mind if I went with you?” he asks.

secret.title: An Answering Address
secret.hint: Bring evidence from the cathedral and the Plateau to Ivo’s statement.
secret.text: You read each of the four names aloud so Mara can check the spelling. Someone knocks twice at the service door. Ivo has his hand on the table. They knock again. He gets up to answer.
